recalls.definition: Every CPSC recall the Recalls API returns with RecallDate on or after the start date, de-duplicated by RecallNumber.

marker.definition: Remedy text matches \bmarkers?\b|\bpermanent\s+maker\b|\b(?:write|writes|writing|written|wrote|mark|marks|marking)\b[^.]{0,60}?["“”'‘’]\s*(?:recall(?:ed)?|do not use|destroyed|void)\b (a marker, or write or mark followed by quoted words such as "RECALLED").

email.definition: Remedy text or ConsumerContact contains an email address ([A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}).

webmail.definition: At least one of those addresses is on one of these domains, exact match: outlook.com, 163.com, gmail.com, hotmail.com, 126.com, qq.com, yeah.net, sina.com, yahoo.com, foxmail.com, aol.com, icloud.com.

under50k.definition: First number in Products[0].NumberOfUnits, times one million when followed by "million". US units as CPSC states them; Canada and Mexico counts in parentheses are not added. Units under 50,000.

comparison.explained: Recall 24078 (Alliance4Safety and 31 furniture companies, 2024-01-11) gives its units as "Millions", with no number. The 2026-11-01 scan read that as 0 units and counted it under 10,000 and under 50,000; this classifier reads it as not given and leaves it out. The shares do not change when rounded: 993 of 1,227 is 81% and 720 of 1,227 is 59%.
